metadata.short_desc: AI image generation with presets, custom prompts, and quotas.
metadata.desc: An AstrBot port of Yunzai Painting.js. Supports remote presets, #bnn text/image-to-image generation, group/user quotas, local image saving, ranking, and API balance lookup.

api_url.hint: OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint or same-origin URL for preset/reference-image generation.

api_key.hint: Fill this in the dashboard. The plugin never hardcodes secrets.

model_name.hint: Used for preset and reference-image generation.

image_model_name.hint: Used for #bnn text-to-image generation, for example gpt-image-2.

api_timeout.hint: Image generation is usually slow; 180-300 seconds is recommended.

bnn_max_count.hint: Limits the number of images per request to reduce abuse.

initial_user_count.hint: Drawing quota automatically assigned on first use.

preset_json_url.hint: GitHub presets are tried first, then this URL, then bundled presets.

master_ids.hint: Separate multiple IDs with commas, spaces, or newlines; used when platform permissions are unavailable.

balance_base_url.hint: Optional. Leave empty to disable #查询额度 / #查余额.

command_prefix.hint: Examples: # / ! / xy / 菲比. If set to xy, use xybnn or xy preset directly.
